verdict.rationale: GlitchTip ships an official CLI (glitchtip-cli) documented for release creation and source map/debug-ID uploads, confirmed by docs and a dedicated CLI doc page, but it is explicitly marked Beta and scoped narrowly to release/source-map workflows rather than broader agentic or general-purpose automation. Missing for 10: evidence of a fully-featured, non-beta CLI covering more operations, and independent/hands-on confirmation of its use.
